title: Move the Pager nurse into a vacant theatre position
summary: Makes four-nurse nights fully editable by letting the remaining Pager nurse fill the absent theatre nurse’s position before Pager is shared.
changes: When one nurse is absent from the five-person establishment, Allocation now opens a four-nurse night-only role arrangement instead of leaving the theatre position unresolved.
The usual full-night Pager nurse is suggested automatically in the vacant theatre position, while all four working nurses remain available so the team can confirm the exact theatre arrangement.
The saved reassignment is shared, audited and used by Night, Full roster and the shared Pager display without changing the permanent rotation.
After theatre positions are confirmed, the four working nurses still choose their shared Pager order separately.
Clock-change timing remains based on real elapsed time, so tonight continues to use four two-hour Pager segments.
